notes.title: Stage Five Update
notes.notes:
The new update is finally here! In our last post we told you about our successful test run at the Dokomi Japan-Expo, and now we release the update for everyone on Steam to enjoy. Here are all the fancy new additions we have in store for you.

Factory Stage

The game gets a major content upgrade with the addition of the Factory as the fifth stage. It features conveyor belts, that disturb your movement, robotic enemies with shock attacks and other dangers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869002/518071179e5dae5d3c6bca582c8339e001834071.gif

Reaper Boss

Leading the army of undead foes in the Town stage is no one else, than the mighty grim reaper – death himself. He is a powerful trickster with a variety of strange abilities. Can you evade his frantic attacks, or will he collect your soul?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869002/95ba16b75364a53ca4944bad1891757ddaff72ab.gif

Additions

 New fifth stage: the factory
 New town boss with soundtrack
 Input mapping screen and new mouse mode
 Stage result bonus screen with coins and stars
 New special attack for Walter
 Conjure venom skill replacing King of the Night for Walter
 Special notes for temple boss
 Effect resistance for amulets
 Visual effect for low energy level
 Stage number and level for region title splash
 Added more information to the status screen
 Added display for status effects


New Enemies

 Eye Walker
 Blinky
 Mini Bit
 Hover Disc
 Cube
 Screamy
 Blight Burster


Adjustments

 Less mask spawns in temple
 Moved drone to factory
 Moved brain crawler to factory
 Owl boss spawns less gnomes
 Adjust damage/health difficulty curve for five stages
 Adjust status effect graphic effect strength
 Enemies move faster when on fire
 Temple boss has more health points
 Scorchling has less health
 Lower chance for Scorchling Rush
 Health upgrades are cheaper but weaker
 Critical chance upgrades are more expensive and weaker
 Status effects do not affect projectile speeds
 Shocking experience des not affect bullets
 Explosions do not pass effects to invincible entities
 Weakened Mirror Shot
 Weakened Target Locked
 Snare damage upgrade has less effect
 More enemies in the mansion
 The mansion boss has more health points
 Astral enemy has more health points
 Companion mimics expire faster
 Flying masks are weaker


Fixes

 Entities on level borders receive damage properly
 Intimidate skill now does not self-terrify the player
 Boss entities can not be cursed
